description: This Java source file defines the ResourcesModifiedStrategy class, which handles ResourcesModified events within the policy persistence actor strategies. The class applies modifications to policies based on resource modification events.

classes.name: ResourcesModifiedStrategy
classes.description: A final class extending AbstractPolicyEventStrategy that processes ResourcesModified events and updates policies accordingly.

methods.name: applyEvent
methods.description: Overrides the applyEvent method to modify the policy based on the resources modified event, returning a new PolicyBuilder instance with the updates applied.
